title: Professional, Innovation Prototyping
note: Hands-on soft-goods prototyping role building garment samples; typically 2 years of experience with a bachelor's; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Full-time salaried prototyping role on Under Armour's innovation team at Baltimore HQ, making apparel prototypes.
facts.duties: Build full and partial garment prototypes using cutting, laser, sewing, heat press, embroidery and pad printing equipment; interpret design sketches and pick construction methods; develop concepts for athletes; check sewability, cost and quality with designers and engineers.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's plus about 2 years related experience (or about 6 years without a degree); must live within commuting distance of Baltimore; in-office; no US sponsorship.
facts.apply: Apply online through the Under Armour careers posting.
